Overview

The x402 Global Challenge PreHack: BLR Edition is a one-day hackathon happening on 23rd August 2026 at Startup Park, Bengaluru, hosted by AlgoBharat to give local builders a head start on x402 before the global challenge really heats up.

The Algorand Global x402 Challenge is live right now, with a $100K+ prize pool up for grabs. This PreHack is Bengaluru's chance to get ahead of it: a focused 12-hour sprint where you build with x402, get mentor support along the way, and leave with a working project you can keep developing for the global stage.

Every project built on this day needs to integrate x402 - the protocol that lets agents and services pay each other automatically, without a human approving every transaction. If you've been curious about what commerce looks like when AI agents are the ones buying and selling, this is where you find out.

Bring an idea, a laptop, and a team of up to three. We'll take care of the rest.

WHY PARTICIPATE

  • Get hands-on, mentor-supported experience building with x402 and AlgoKit.
  • Build a working, open-source project that you can carry forward into the Algorand Global x402 Challenge.
  • Experiment with agentic commerce and real-world payment use cases.
  • Connect and collaborate with builders from Bengaluru's developer ecosystem.

ORGANISED BY & PARTNERS

This hackathon is brought to life by four organisations working together:

  • KrowdKraft (Host) - A Bengaluru-based open-source and tech community that brings builders together through workshops, seminars, and hackathons, fostering collaboration and innovation across emerging technologies.

  • AlgoBharat (Powered By) - The Algorand Foundation-backed community driving Algorand adoption across India, connecting developers and students through hackathons, workshops, and regional chapters.

  • Buildora (Innovation Partner) - The hackathon platform powering registrations, project submissions, and community engagement, making it seamless for participants to build, collaborate, and showcase their ideas.

  • Algorand (Build On) - The high-performance, carbon-negative blockchain behind it all, built for real-world scale with instant finality, low transaction fees, and a developer-friendly stack (AlgoKit) that makes building and shipping on-chain applications straightforward.

Build with x402, ship something real in Bengaluru, and take your project forward to compete on the global stage.

Idea Submission

This is the selection round for the x402 Global Challenge PreHack – Bengaluru. Teams are required to submit a brief overview of their proposed solution. Selected teams will be invited to participate in the in-person hackathon.

Please keep the following in mind:

  • Your solution must include at least one x402-enabled endpoint as part of your application.
  • Your project must be built on Algorand and should leverage the Algorand ecosystem wherever applicable.
  • Clearly describe the problem statement, your proposed solution, and how x402 and Algorand are integrated into your project.
  • Teams are encouraged to start building their solution before the hackathon. This will allow you to make the most of mentor support during the event and present a polished Minimum Viable Product (MVP) on the hack day.
  • Before submitting your idea, please go through the Resources section to understand x402, Algorand, the available SDKs, and integration guides.

Note: While selected teams can refine or improve their solution during the hackathon based on mentor feedback, the core idea submitted during this phase should remain aligned with the project you present on the final day.

Events

x402 Workshop

Aug 16, 2026, 12:30 PMworkshop
Get hands-on with x402 before hack day. We’ll cover how x402 payments work, how to build a paid endpoint on Algorand, interesting agentic use cases, and everything you need to know for the x402 Global Challenge PreHack including requirements, judging, submissions, and what to focus on while building. The goal is to make sure you come into the hackathon ready to build, not spend the first few hours figuring out the stack.

Eligibility

  • Open to everyone - students, working developers, and Web3-curious builders
  • No age cap, no eligibility restrictions
  • Teams of 1-3 members; cross-college and cross-company teams welcome

Rules

  1. Theme is mandatory: Every project must integrate or incorporate x402 and have to be built on Algorand blockchain. If your submission does not feature x402 on the Algorand blockchain, will not be accepted for judging.
  2. Team size: Teams can have a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 3 members.
  3. No last-minute team formation: Teams must be finalized at the time of registration. Changing or forming teams on the day of the event is not allowed.
  4. Hackathon Project Build Time: Projects can be pre-built prior to the hackathon, since participants get limited time during the hack window.
  5. Submission requirement: Your project must have at least 1 functional x402 paid endpoint and a working MVP, submitted before the 5:00 PM deadline.
  6. Late submissions: Submissions made after 5:00 PM will not be considered.
  7. Filtering round: Not all teams will present to the final judges. Teams are shortlisted for the final round based on the submission requirement above.
  8. Original work only: Plagiarized code, ideas, or projects copied from other participants or external sources will lead to disqualification.
  9. Respectful conduct: Participants are expected to maintain professionalism and respect toward fellow participants, mentors, judges, and organizers throughout the event.
  10. Organizer decisions are final: All decisions made by the organizing team and judges regarding eligibility, scoring, and winners are final and binding.
